tools.name: get_tides
tools.description: Get tide predictions (high/low water times and heights) for a port or coordinates. Returns extremes with datetime, height in meters, and type (high/low). Supports 18,400+ stations worldwide.

tools.name: search_ports
tools.description: Search for tide stations by name or country. Returns port name, slug, coordinates, timezone, country.

tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: List all 188 countries that have tide stations, with their station counts and ISO codes.

tools.name: get_weather
tools.description: Get weather forecast (temperature, wind, precipitation, UV, conditions) for a port or coordinates. Returns hourly and daily data.

tools.name: get_marine
tools.description: Get ocean and wave forecast (wave height, swell, sea state on Douglas scale). Returns hourly and daily data.

tools.name: get_astronomy
tools.description: Get sun and moon data: sunrise, sunset, dawn, dusk, day length, moon phase, illumination, moonrise, moonset.

tools.name: get_conditions
tools.description: Get unified weather + marine + astronomy data in one call. More efficient than calling each separately.

tools.name: get_history
tools.description: Get historical tide predictions and weather data for past dates. Tides up to 365 days, weather up to 90 days.

tools.name: get_observations
tools.description: Get real-time sea level observations from REFMAR/SHOM tide gauges (French stations only). Returns 10-minute interval readings.

tools.name: get_radar
tools.description: Get rain radar tile URLs for a location. Returns past frames and short-term nowcast frames for map overlays.
